_about: Officials who hold views about a chartered company, with what they care about. Matched in game by plugin + base form ID (verified 2026-11-20 against Mantella's skyrim_characters.csv). weights say how much each concern moves their view (they need not add up to 1): compliance = terms kept; restraint = the company stays within what its charter level allows (the power gap); thrift = the company does not cost the court more than agreed and stays solvent; standing = how the Jarl himself now regards the player; regard = their own feelings about the player (trust, affinity, respect). L1 has the three officials closest to the charter; Hrongar, the Battle-Borns, the Gray-Manes, Caius and the farmers join in L6.
